summary: Each Product can have a low-stock level in its main unit (CatalogProduct.lowStockLevel, nullable). inventory.setLowStockLevel saves or clears it; balance rows carry it; the dashboard Inventory page shows Running low (status, tile, filter) and a Low-stock level sheet from the row menu.
noAssistantImpact: Display setting only: it never blocks a sale or changes stock. The assistant keeps reading low stock through lowStockPage with its own threshold; balance answers ignore the new field. inventory.setLowStockLevel is classified form_only.

procedures.reason: Running low display setting on the Inventory page; no stock change.

evidence.result: Save, clear, negative refused, other tenant not found: pass.
Running low at or below the level, loose stock only, summary and filter: pass.
